title: Restaurant Review Analysis Report
executive_summary: An analysis of 14 customer reviews reveals key areas of concern regarding food quality and pricing. Approximately 28.6% of reviews highlighted issues in these areas, indicating that inconsistent kitchen standards and perceived poor value are negatively impacting customer satisfaction.
key_findings: Customers reporting poor food quality in multiple reviews (frequency: 28.57%)
Customers complaining about high or unfair pricing (frequency: 28.57%)

root_causes.pattern: Customers reporting poor food quality in multiple reviews
root_causes.cause: Inconsistent kitchen preparation or declining ingredient standards during peak hours

root_causes.pattern: Customers complaining about high or unfair pricing
root_causes.cause: Discrepancy between customer expectations and menu pricing, potentially exacerbated by drops in perceived food quality

recommendations.issue: Inconsistent kitchen preparation and declining ingredient standards during peak hours leading to poor food quality.
recommendations.action: Implement strict kitchen standard operating procedures (SOPs), introduce a mandatory plating and quality check by the head chef before dishes leave the pass, and audit key supplier ingredients.
recommendations.expected_impact: Significant reduction in food quality complaints and improved consistency across all service times.

recommendations.issue: Customer perception of high or unfair pricing exacerbated by drops in food quality.
recommendations.action: Conduct a comprehensive menu engineering review to ensure portion sizes and ingredient values justify current prices, and temporarily run promotional value-add offers while food quality stabilizes.
recommendations.expected_impact: Alignment of customer price-to-value expectations, leading to fewer negative reviews regarding cost.

limitations: Small sample size of only 14 reviews may not represent the broader customer base
Review data inherently contains self-selection bias, leaning toward extreme positive or negative experiences
